topography.project_purpose: Yield Aggregator. Structurally: 105 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 20 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 13 common project-authored base contract(s) (tokenholder, governable, upgradeableproxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
